title: Tootey Taarey Ka Safar
excerpt: Ek chhote gaon ka ladka Arjun khet mein ek chamakti cheez dhundhta hai. Sab kehte hain pagal hai, lekin Arjun ko vishwaas hai yeh toota taara hai.

title: Ek Cup Chai
excerpt: Ek billionaire CEO ka driver nahi aaya. Auto se office jaate waqt ek chai wale ne usse zindagi ki sabse badi seekh de di.

title: Purani Haveli Ka Chirag
excerpt: Ek NRI apni purani haveli bechne aaya. Lekin haveli mein mila ek purana chirag jisne usse apni asli virasat dikhayi.

title: Wapsi
excerpt: Manoj 20 saal baad apne gaon lautta hai. Sab badal gaya hai - lekin ek cheez nahi badli. Woh kya thi?

title: 98 Percent Ka Sach
excerpt: Riya class topper thi - 98%. Sabki aankhon ka taara. Lekin ek din usse pata chala ki 98% ke peeche ka sach kitna khaali hai.

title: Screen Se Bahar
excerpt: Aditya ka poora din phone mein jaata tha. Ek din phone toot gaya aur 7 din bina phone ke - woh 7 din uski zindagi badal gaye.

title: Haar Ke Baad
excerpt: Aryan state level ka final haar gaya. Lekin us haar ke baad jo hua - woh kisi trophy se bada tha.

title: Woh Ek Din
excerpt: Sahil ko roz school mein bully kiya jaata tha. Ek din usne stage par kuch aisa kiya jisne bully ko bhi rula diya.

title: Jungle Ka Rahasya
excerpt: Teen dost jungle mein gaye aur unhe mila ek aisa rahasya jisne unki zindagi badal di. Kya tha woh rahasya?

title: Dadi Ki Jadui Rasoi
excerpt: Dadi ka khaana itna tasty kyun hota tha? Kya unki rasoi mein sach mein jaadu tha? Ek pote ne dhundha asli raaz.

title: Pahaad Ka Hero
excerpt: Jab baadh aane wali thi aur koi nahi maan raha tha, ek 11 saal ke ladke ne akele poore gaon ko bachaya.

title: Chor Aur Jadui Chirag
excerpt: Ek chor ko mila jadui chirag jismein teen wishes thin. Lekin har wish ne usse aur mushkil mein daal diya!

title: Rangbirangi Titli
excerpt: Ek titli thi jise apne rang pasand nahi the. Lekin jab usne jaana ki har rang ka ek kaam hai, toh uski duniya badal gayi!

title: Motu Haathi Aur Chhotu Chuha
excerpt: Jungle ka sabse bada haathi sabse chhote chuhe se darta tha! Lekin ek din dono ki dosti ne poora jungle bacha liya.

title: Jadui Baarish
excerpt: Ek din jungle mein aasmaan se toffees aur chocolates barsne lagi! Sab khush. Lekin ek buddhimaan ullu ne bataya asli jadoo kya hai.

title: Chanda Mama Ka Tohfa
excerpt: Gudiya roz raat ko chanda mama se baatein karti thi. Ek raat chanda mama ne usse ek aisa tohfa diya jo sabse keemti tha.
